## Goal

One sentence: what should this issue change?

## Why

What problem does it solve / which roadmap item does it advance?

## Scope (what is in)

- [ ] Concrete deliverable 1
- [ ] Concrete deliverable 2

## Out of scope (what is NOT in)

- Anything bigger that should be a separate issue.

## Files likely involved

- `path/to/file.ts`
- `path/to/other.tsx`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Behavior X works as described
- [ ] No regression in `npm run build`
- [ ] No new dependency added (or discussed first if needed)

## Estimated effort

~N hours / ~N files

## Hints

(Optional) Pointers to related code, docs, or design notes.

## Want to take this?

Comment "I'd like to take this" and I'll confirm within 24h.
